settings.heading: soft pauses vs. typical perimenopause supplements.

settings.question: is this HRT?
settings.answer: no. soft pauses is not a hormone and not a drug. it is a daily plant-based support. if you are exploring HRT, we recommend finding a menopause-trained physician. the menopause society maintains a directory.

settings.question: how long until i feel something?
settings.answer: most women report a difference in energy and mood within the first two to four weeks of daily use. perimenopause symptoms are not linear, and neither is the support. give it a full 30 days.

settings.question: why a patch and not a pill?
settings.answer: pills require a digestive system, a routine, and a memory. a patch is once a day, on the skin, done. for a lot of women in perimenopause, that simplicity is the whole point.

settings.question: where do i wear the patch?
settings.answer: the inside of the forearm, the shoulder, or the upper hip work best. anywhere with thin, clean skin. rotate placement to avoid skin irritation.

settings.question: how does the subscription work?
settings.answer: your first order ships free with 20% off. after that, you get a fresh 30-day supply every 30 days at the subscription price. you can pause, skip, change cadence, or cancel from your account in one click.

settings.question: how do i cancel?
settings.answer: log in, click cancel. it takes about 10 seconds. no phone calls, no chat queues, no "wait, before you go" modals.

settings.question: can i pause or skip a month?
settings.answer: yes. pause for any reason, any length. skip a month, skip three. resume whenever you want.

settings.question: when will my order ship?
settings.answer: orders placed before 1pm ET ship the same business day. you'll get a tracking number by email. delivery is typically 2–5 business days within the US.

settings.question: do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: we ship within the US and Canada today. the EU and UK are on the roadmap for q3.

settings.question: what if it doesn't work for me?
settings.answer: send it back within 30 days for a full refund. no questions, no forms, no friction.

settings.question: is maca safe for me?
settings.answer: maca has been used for centuries and is generally well-tolerated. if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, on thyroid medication, or being treated for a hormone-sensitive condition, please talk to your doctor before starting.

settings.question: can i take this with HRT?
settings.answer: most women on HRT can use soft pauses as a daily floor of support. confirm with your prescribing physician first. we are not a replacement for a treatment your doctor has prescribed.

settings.question: are there side effects?
settings.answer: the most common is mild skin irritation at the patch site, usually from leaving the patch on the same spot. rotate placement and it typically resolves. discontinue use if irritation persists.

settings.question: is this hsa/fsa eligible?
settings.answer: yes, with a letter of medical necessity through truemed (free, takes about 5 minutes at checkout). the vast majority of applicants are approved.
